# Launch post

## English

**AI;DR, what's new in AI today, ranked**

AI news is spread across Hacker News, Hugging Face, lab blogs, GitHub releases, and a long tail of RSS feeds. The same model release shows up five times with five headlines. I built AI;DR to read all of it and hand back one short list.

Every 30 minutes, a pipeline fetches new stories from its sources, removes duplicates, and merges stories that cover the same event. JEV rates each story for AI relevance and quality, and an LLM takes over when JEV is unavailable. Then plain code ranks everything by importance and quality. No person picks the order, and the ranking rules are public in `ALGORITHM.md` on GitHub.

The top stories of the last 24 hours become the day's edition, up to 16 short bullets written once in English and once in Vietnamese. At most 5 stories from one source family, 6 when one is top-tier, so a single busy source does not push out the rest. Every bullet links to the original post.

You can read the edition where you already are.

- **Web** at https://aidr.today
- **Email** from 07:00 in your timezone, with 3, 5, or 10 stories, daily or weekly. Sign up at https://aidr.today/subscribe
- **Telegram** at @aidr_today in English and @aihomnay in Vietnamese
- **Facebook**, where the English Page posts each edition
- **RSS** at https://aidr.today/feed.xml
- **Chrome**, as a new tab page with the ranked list
- **AI agents**, through a public MCP server documented at https://aidr.today/mcp. Read tools such as `latest_ai_news`, `search_news`, and `get_ai_digest` need no key.

A machine picks the stories, so it gets some wrong. If you see a bad line, sign in and suggest a better one, or email submit@aidr.today. The code is open source.

Start at https://aidr.today

### Telegram, English (@aidr_today)

```
AI;DR ranks AI news every 30 minutes.
From 08:00 Vietnam time, this channel posts the day's top AI stories, each linked to the source.
Full edition at https://aidr.today
```

### Facebook

```
AI;DR ranks AI news every 30 minutes and posts the day's edition here. No editor picks the order. Every story links to the original post.

Get it by email, Telegram, RSS, or in a Chrome new tab at https://aidr.today/subscribe
```

# Positioning

## Who it is for

People who follow AI news every day and want one short list instead of ten tabs. That includes engineers, researchers, and founders, and readers in Vietnam who want the same news in Vietnamese.

## The problem

AI news is spread across Hacker News, Hugging Face, lab blogs, GitHub releases, and RSS feeds. The same story shows up five times with five headlines. Reading all of it takes time, and a lot of it is not about AI.

## What it does

AI;DR reads AI news sources every 30 minutes, removes duplicates, scores each story, and ranks them. The top stories of the last 24 hours become one edition, written in English and in Vietnamese. That edition goes out on the site, by email, on Telegram, on a Facebook Page, over RSS, in a Chrome new tab, and to AI agents over MCP. Every item links to the original post.

## How it differs

- **No editor picks the order.** A fixed pipeline does it in steps (fetch, dedupe, enrich, score, merge, translate, rank). The rank step is pure code, and the rules are public in `ALGORITHM.md`.
- **Two languages, written separately.** The Vietnamese bullets are restated on their own. If one language is not ready, that channel waits for the next run instead of posting the other language.
- **One edition, many channels.** The site, email, Telegram, Facebook, and the extension read the same ranked edition.
- **Open to agents.** The public MCP server lets an agent read the news without an API key.
- **Open source.** The code and the ranking contract are on GitHub.

## Proof points

| Claim | Evidence |
|---|---|
| A run starts every 30 minutes | `README.md` "Pipeline", `apps/web/ALGORITHM.md` "Scheduling & coalesce" (25-minute coalesce, `INGEST_MIN_INTERVAL_MS`) |
| Sources include Hacker News, Hugging Face, GitHub releases, Lobsters, RSS | Adapters in `apps/web/worker/sources/` (`hn.ts`, `hfpapers.ts`, `hfmodels.ts`, `hftrending.ts`, `githubreleases.ts`, `lobsters.ts`, `rss.ts`), registered in `registry.ts`. The live list is at https://aidr.today/data?tab=sources |
| Duplicates are merged | `ALGORITHM.md` §2 Dedupe and §5 Merge |
| Ranking is pure code | `ALGORITHM.md` §7 Rank, `apps/web/worker/ranking.ts` |
| JEV rates each story, and an LLM scores it when JEV is unavailable | `ALGORITHM.md` §4 Score, https://aidr.today/about |
| The daily digest is up to 16 bullets per language from the last 24 hours | `ALGORITHM.md` §10 TL;DR, `apps/web/worker/tldr.ts` |
| At most 5 stories from one source family, 6 when one is top-tier | `ALGORITHM.md` §10, `apps/web/worker/digest/select.ts` |
| English and Vietnamese never fill in for each other | `CLAUDE.md`, `apps/web/worker/digest/edition.ts` |
| Email from 07:00 in the reader's timezone, 3, 5, or 10 stories, daily or weekly | `ALGORITHM.md` "Overview" publish notes, `apps/web/worker/subscribe/handlers.ts` (`DIGEST_SIZES`) |
| Telegram in Vietnamese (@aihomnay) and English (@aidr_today), from 08:00 Vietnam time | `ALGORITHM.md` "Overview" publish notes, `apps/web/src/lib/site.ts` |
| An English Facebook Page post per edition | `ALGORITHM.md` "Overview" publish notes, `apps/web/worker/notify/facebook.ts` |
| RSS feed | https://aidr.today/feed.xml (`README.md`) |
| Chrome new tab extension | `apps/extension`, Chrome Web Store link in `README.md` |
| Public MCP read tools with no auth (`latest_ai_news`, `search_news`, `get_story`, `get_ai_digest`, `get_day_edition`) | `apps/web/worker/mcp/public-tools.ts`, https://aidr.today/mcp |
| Every story links to its source | https://aidr.today/about, `SITE_DESCRIPTION` in `apps/web/src/lib/site.ts` |
| Readers can send fixes and stories | https://aidr.today/about (`submit@aidr.today`, suggest a line when signed in) |

## Voice

- Short sentences. Facts first, then the link.
- Say what the pipeline does, with its numbers ("every 30 minutes", "16 bullets", "from 07:00").
- Admit the limits. A machine picks the stories, so it makes mistakes, and readers can fix them.
- Write the name as **AI;DR** and the domain as **aidr.today**. "AI News" is the SEO title, not the brand (`SITE_NAME` note in `apps/web/src/lib/site.ts`).

Words to avoid: revolutionary, game-changing, cutting-edge, seamless, powerful, leverage, unlock, supercharge, curated by experts, never miss anything, all the AI news. Do not say "real-time", because runs are 30 minutes apart. Do not say "human-curated", because no person picks the order.

## Overview

One ingest run does three jobs. The scheduler starts one every 30 minutes, with a 25-minute coalesce (`INGEST_MIN_INTERVAL_MS`). Prompts live in `worker/llm.ts`; the steps live in `worker/ingest/` (one module per step), run in order by `worker/workflow.ts`.

| Phase | What it writes | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Consume | Source rows become `items` (fetch, dedupe, enrich) | `worker/sources/`, `worker/dedupe.ts`, `worker/enrich.ts` |
| Rank | Scores, translations, `rank_score`, then today's `tldr_snapshots` row (`bullets_en`, `bullets_vi`) | `worker/llm.ts`, `worker/ranking.ts`, `worker/tldr.ts` |
| Publish | The same edition, per language, with no cross-language fill-in | `worker/digest/edition.ts` |

Publish has two deliveries and they do not share a clock or a table:

- **Email** (`worker/subscribe/send.ts`) — two lanes, English and Vietnamese. From 07:00 in each subscriber's timezone. Size 3/5/10 (default 5) and layout (`no-images`, `design`, `large` or `text`, see `src/lib/mail-format.ts`) and headline font (`sans` or `serif`, see `src/lib/mail-font.ts`, `subscribers.mail_font`) come from that subscriber. The subject leads with the top headlines plus "+N more"; the preheader is written, not story text (§11). Idempotency is `subscribers.last_sent_date`. Subscribers with `frequency = weekly` skip these lanes and get the weekly edition on Monday morning instead (§11, idempotency `last_weekly_sent`). A browser preview through the same `renderEditionEmail` is `GET /api/subscribe/preview?lang=&n=&format=&font=`.
- **Telegram** (`worker/notify/`) — VI (`telegram`) and EN (`telegram-en`), from 08:00 `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`, one message with the day card's 6 stories, once per channel per local date in `notifications`. Trending stories use the same caps on every notifier.
- **Facebook** (`worker/notify/facebook.ts`) — English Page (`facebook-en`) when `FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID` and `FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN` are set. Same digest hour and the same trending bar, cap and gap. One Graph `/{page-id}/feed` link post per send. Facebook scrapes that site for the preview. The Worker uploads no photo or video. Unset Page id and token leave the channel off. A policy or auth error is not retried. `pnpm facebook:mint` writes a new Page token into `.env.local`. Story links carry `utm_content=post-<id8>` (Telegram: `button-<id8>`, `link-<id8>`), the story id's first 8 characters. Once a day, behind the ingest alarm, `worker/notify/facebook-insights.ts` reads `post_media_view` and `post_clicks` for the last 12 sent posts into `post_stats` (migration 0073). A token without `read_insights` ends the run with NULL rows and no retry that day.

An empty `bullets_vi` or `bullets_en` means that language is not ready. The channel skips and the next run retries. Notifiers strip page chrome and a trailing outlet credit from each bullet (`stripEmbeddedChrome`), drop a bullet that strips to nothing, and only then take the top `DIGEST_MAX_BULLETS`. A snapshot whose every bullet strips to nothing skips as `empty_after_strip`, not `no_snapshot`. Email is not a `Notifier`: a notifier is one target plus a trending post.

### 10. TL;DR (LLM)

Every run (30 minutes).

- Generate today's **local** snapshot (`Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh` date key —
  same identity the Telegram digest looks up for once-per-local-day
  send) if missing, thin, EN-only (`bullets_vi` empty), or
  **English-only `bullets_vi` while `title_vi` now exists**.
- Otherwise refresh a useful bilingual snapshot when the last write is
  older than 3 hours.
- Content is always the top 16 items of the **rolling last 24h** by
  rank (not ICT calendar-day-so-far), after `selectEdition`
  (`worker/digest/select.ts`) → up to 16 EN bullets + 16
  independently-restated VI bullets, each linked to its `item_id`.
- `selectEdition` is the top-list family cap (5 of 16 per family) with
  importance deciding what the cap may cut. It reorders only the top 32
  rows (`CONTENTION_DEPTH` × 16); deeper rows lost on rank (age, quality),
  not on the cap (on 2026-10-14 an 8.5 sat at #110, a day old). Over the
  rank-ordered pool, each step taking only what the earlier ones left:
  1. The top 32, importance ≥ 5, in rank order, 5 per family. An
     importance-8+ row the cap would cut takes a 6th slot for its family
     (`EDITION_TOP_TIER_LIFT` = 1). Slots for the 8+ rows are held back
     before the walk, so each comes off the edition's lowest-ranked other
     story of any family (an 8+ row can push out its own family's tail
